games.title: Language Choice
games.description: Choose the form that makes the unit language accurate.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'Fair Effort, Daily Gains': I had to ______ two languages to serve everyone here.
choices: cancel
leave
master
continue
rounds.answer: master
rounds.explanation: Omar had to learn both languages very well, which is what master means.

rounds.prompt: Which question is written correctly for an interview?
choices: When you leave for work?
What she does every day?
Why you speak two languages at work?
When do you leave for work?
rounds.answer: When do you leave for work?
rounds.explanation: An interview question needs its helping verb: when plus do plus you plus leave.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses a conjunction to show a difference?
choices: I wanted to play outside, but it started to rain.
She runs fast because she has plenty of speed and energy.
I write the mail and maintain the records.
Would you like football or basketball?
rounds.answer: I wanted to play outside, but it started to rain.
rounds.explanation: But joins two opposite ideas; because gives a reason, and adds, or offers a choice.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use unit evidence to solve each reading clue.

rounds.prompt: Which word in the text means calm and quiet, with no trouble?
choices: The word is peace, which Omar says a letter can bring.
She writes that she usually arrives early, so lateness is not her pattern.
He can serve almost every customer in town, whichever language they use.
rounds.answer: The word is peace, which Omar says a letter can bring.
rounds.explanation: Omar links letters to peace, so the surrounding words give the meaning away.

rounds.prompt: What reason does Omar give for saying that mail is still important?
choices: She writes that she usually arrives early, so lateness is not her pattern.
She enjoys the daily reading time, because she says she really likes it.
Not everyone owns a phone, so a letter helps someone feel remembered.
rounds.answer: Not everyone owns a phone, so a letter helps someone feel remembered.
rounds.explanation: Omar answers with because, and the reason follows straight after it.

rounds.prompt: Why is it useful that Omar speaks two languages at the shop?
choices: He means he does the same job every day, in a steady pattern.
He can serve almost every customer in town, whichever language they use.
Not everyone owns a phone, so a letter helps someone feel remembered.
rounds.answer: He can serve almost every customer in town, whichever language they use.
rounds.explanation: The text puts his two languages and serving every customer in the same sentence.

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Read each unit question carefully and choose the best answer.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence puts the adverb of frequency in the right place?
choices: I check usually the mail.
I usually check the mail.
Usually check I the mail.
I check the mail usually not.
rounds.answer: I usually check the mail.
rounds.explanation: Frequency adverbs sit between the subject and the main verb.

rounds.prompt: Which word completes this sentence: It is ______ to wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
choices: cancel
mail
speed
necessary
rounds.answer: necessary
rounds.explanation: Necessary means needed or very important, and the frame needs a describing word.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'balance' mean?
choices: To say that something will not happen any more.
Having an equal, steady amount on each side.
To go away from a place.
In a way that is easy to see, hear or understand.
rounds.answer: Having an equal, steady amount on each side.
rounds.explanation: Balance is the steady, equal share Amal keeps between work and free time.

games.title: Unit Mission
games.description: Finish with a mixed challenge across the whole unit.

rounds.prompt: What does the word 'peace' mean?
choices: Letters and packages that are sent or delivered.
The hard work you put into doing something.
A time when there is calm and quiet, with no fighting or trouble.
A way people talk and write to share ideas and feelings.
rounds.answer: A time when there is calm and quiet, with no fighting or trouble.
rounds.explanation: Peace names a calm, quiet time; the other options define mail, effort and language.

rounds.prompt: Which sentence uses the verb pattern after 'agree' correctly?
choices: She agrees to send the mail.
She agrees send the mail.
She agrees sending the mail tomorrow.
She agree to send the mail.
rounds.answer: She agrees to send the mail.
rounds.explanation: Agree takes to and a verb, and the subject she needs agrees, not agree.

rounds.prompt: Choose the missing word from 'A Day at the Post Counter': Every morning he sorts the ______, weighs the parcels, and helps people send letters.
choices: mail
balance
citizen
speed
rounds.answer: mail
rounds.explanation: The text says he sorts the mail, which is what arrives to be delivered.
